steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Enable the required eRFX project capability for the test tenant.
Work on the Auction stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Add one product for the vendor to quote.
Invite the named vendor required by the scenario.
Publish the event so Vendor A can access it.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Open the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's Auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Accept the required terms before submitting the quote.
Enter a bid of 100 in the vendor portal and submit it.
Verify the vendor portal records the bid as submitted.
Check that the vendor portal exposes the rank indicator after submission, while the catalog cannot assert its exact updated value.
